feed.headline: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin
feed.ai: An end to the conflict in Ukraine "will not be achieved through silence," Finland's President Alexander Stubb said.

feed.headline: Celebrations in Serbia after veteran ruler Vučić loses election to student-led protest movement
feed.ai: The populist right-wing leader of 12 years says it is "clear" his party has lost the vote billed as a referendum on the country's future.

feed.headline: Joy and disbelief on Serbian streets as Vučić concedes election defeat
feed.ai: BBC correspondent Nick Thorpe reports from Belgrade, where there were rapturous celebrations following the victory of the student-led movement.

feed.headline: Rosenberg: Russia agrees to Ukraine talks but sees little to talk about in new peace push
feed.ai: President Vladimir Putin does not feel under pressure right now to end the war, the BBC's Russia Editor writes.

feed.headline: Who actually controls Ukraine's access to Starlink?
feed.ai: President Zelensky says limits to the technology continue to affect Ukrainian forces, while US officials and Elon Musk offer conflicting accounts of who controls it.

feed.headline: Are the French riots a warning of an intense election to come?
feed.ai: Rioting, looting and vandalism has gripped France over the weekend after protests spiralled out of control across the country.

feed.headline: Behind Italy’s Protests: Rising Prices and Sinking Hopes
feed.ai: Inspired in part by French demonstrations, protests in Italy by students in the north and truckers in the south could affect national elections next year.

feed.headline: How to Tax and Spend in a ‘Turbulent Time’? U.K. Tries a Balancing Act.
feed.ai: The new government, led by Andy Burnham, will deliver its first budget on Wednesday, a plan expected to tread between wide ambition and narrow financial limits.

feed.headline: Judge Limits Candace Owens’s Liability in Macron Defamation Case
feed.ai: The French president, Emmanuel Macron, and his wife, Brigitte, sued Candace Owens in 2025 over claims she made about Ms. Macron’s gender. A judge said the court had jurisdiction over her companies but not her.

feed.headline: Trump Explores Lifting Sanctions on Russia’s Flagship Investment Fund
feed.ai: The move would be the latest U.S. concession to Moscow as President Trump pursues economic incentives he hopes will secure an end to war in Ukraine.

feed.headline: Serbian Students, Victorious and Leaderless, Go After the Media
feed.ai: Supporters of the opposition movement that won Sunday’s election stormed the offices of a pro-government tabloid. Another news outlet apologized for years of “one-sided” coverage.

feed.headline: In the A.I. ‘Robogym,’ Machines Train to Be More Like Humans
feed.ai: Germany’s Neura is one of the companies at the forefront of efforts to use artificial intelligence in robotics, and crucial to whether Europe can close the gap with China.
